rationale: A wins because it keeps the strategy story grounded: "Substack adds native video as it pushes from newsletter tool to media app" is supported by the update and boxed in with real proof requirements. B has sharper copy in places, but "Substack has stopped competing with Mailchimp and started competing with YouTube" is a neat line built from facts the prompt did not give you. A is less showy and more pitchable; B warns against hallucinated platform-war framing while doing it anyway.
gaps_in_A: "the same cut now extending over video and podcast monetization" overstates the fact block. The update says Substack takes 10% of subscription revenue; it does not prove the cut applies identically to video or podcast monetization.

"Substack is spending on a media-app build while privately held and short on funding" pushes "public funding struggles" into a stronger distress claim. A flags the thinness, but the headline still outruns the evidence.

A misses the sharper labor/professional-identity version of the creator angle: whether writers are being nudged into video production. Its creator angle is economically valid, but narrower than it could be.
gaps_in_B: "Substack has stopped competing with Mailchimp and started competing with YouTube" invents the competitive frame. The facts name neither company, and B's own refused list rejects almost the same move.

"the people who chose Substack precisely because it was text now face a feed that rewards something they didn't sign up to make" invents creator motivation and feed incentives. Those might be reportable questions, not supplied facts.

"A reporter can do arithmetic on that publicly" is too glib. With an undisclosed "top creators" denominator, the 4 million paid subscriptions figure does not let a reporter calculate much without making mush.

"venture-backed consumer platforms" and "10% take on a 4-million-subscription base" add imprecision. The update says privately held, public funding struggles, and 4 million paid subscriptions across all publications; it does not establish the finance framing cleanly.
